# homelab Provider

Helpers for directory discovery and declarative FCOS deployment over SSH. Requires Terraform 1.8+ or OpenTofu 1.8+. See the deployment resource for host prerequisites and secret handling.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    homelab = {
      source = "savely-krasovsky/homelab-helpers"
    }
  }
}

provider "homelab" {}
```
